pages.title: Otherworld Sapling Trader
pages.text: Otherworld Trees grown from natural Otherworld Saplings can only be harvested$(br)when under the effect of $(#AA00AA)Third Eye$(). To make life easier, the Otherworld Sapling Trader$(br)will exchange such natural saplings for a stable variant that can be $()

pages.title: Otherworld Sapling Trader
pages.text: harvested$(br)by anyone, and will drop the same stable saplings when harvested.$(br)
To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,$(br)he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.$(br)
